title: School principal shot dead in his minivan near his home in Salbu, Datu Saudi-Ampatuan
summary: Dionel Villabito Mahusay, principal of Datu Pendililang Elementary School in neighbouring Datu Piang, was shot by armed men who blocked his minivan about 50 metres from his house in Barangay Salbu, Datu Saudi-Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur, at about 8:20 a.m. on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, according to the Police Regional Office-BAR. His family rushed him home, and he died. No shell casings were found and the motive was not known. Education Minister Naguib Sinarimbo condemned the killing and called for the gunmen to be caught.

title: Businessman shot dead in his car in Malangit, Pandag
summary: Businessman Muda Hussim was in a Suzuki sedan when a group of men opened fire on him in Barangay Malangit, Pandag, Maguindanao del Sur, on Monday, 16 November 2026, according to the Bangsamoro police. He was declared dead on arrival at a nearby hospital.

title: Lending-company collector shot dead and his companion wounded in an ambush in Kitulaan, Kapalawan
summary: Jingle Pestanas, a collector for a Kidapawan lending company, was riding a motorcycle with a companion when a group of men ambushed them in Barangay Kitulaan, Kapalawan, in the Special Geographic Area, on Monday, 16 November 2026, according to the Bangsamoro police. Pestanas died of multiple gunshot wounds, and his companion was taken to hospital with gunshot wounds.
